name: Sitting At Jesus Feet
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound significance of sitting at Jesus' feet as an expression of devoted discipleship and attentive learning. In Luke 10, Mary exemplifies this posture by sitting at Jesus' feet to hear His word, highlighting the priority of spiritual nourishment over busyness. This setting in Bethany, where Jesus was welcomed into the home of Simon the leper and where He raised Lazarus from the dead, underscores the intimate fellowship and transformative encounters that occur when one draws near to Christ. These passages collectively emphasize the importance of positioning oneself humbly before Jesus to receive His teaching and grace.
